from work import evaluate
base={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':4,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}
cases=[
('preserve_false_zero_empty',{'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},base,{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''},'error':None}),
('ordered_and_reset',{'layers':[{'i':9},{'i':None}]},base,{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':4,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
('null_without_reset',{'layers':[{'i':None}]},{**base,'null_resets':False},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
('unknown_precedes_environment',{'layers':[{'bad':1}],'environment':{'i':'oops'}},base,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),
('environment_disabled',{'environment':{'i':'2'}},{**base,'environment':False},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
('environment_unknown',{'environment':{'bad':'2'}},base,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
('environment_exact_parsing',{'environment':{'b':'false','i':'-12','s':''}},base,{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':-12,'s':''},'error':None}),
('environment_bad_bool',{'environment':{'b':'True'}},base,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
('environment_bad_int',{'environment':{'i':' 2'}},base,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
('bool_not_integer',{'layers':[{'i':False}]},base,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
('type_after_environment',{'layers':[{'i':'bad'}],'environment':{'i':'7'}},base,{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':7,'s':'x'},'error':None})]
for name,request,policy,expected in cases:
 actual=evaluate(request,policy)
 assert actual==expected,(name,actual,expected)
 print(name,actual['error'] or 'ok')
